shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical rectangular stone surface
small circular disc or rosette motifs
raised outlines against a flat recessed ground
held or carried objects (bucket-like / rod-like shapes)
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented stone slabs bearing low relief with profile creatures and small disc motifs carved as raised outlines against a flat ground, which is the most concrete correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A stacks small, schematic, flatly incised animals in horizontal registers across a weathered in-situ block, while B is dominated by a single large, anatomically modelled winged figure with dense, finely tooled internal detail filling the whole field.
